newsitem.title: UK: Both Feb 18-20 Brent cargoes "clocked" - trade.
newsitem.headline: Both Feb 18-20 Brent cargoes "clocked" - trade.

text.p: Both Brent cargoes turning wet on Monday were unclaimed at the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
One of the cargoes, which are due to load Feb 18-20, was "clocked" to Wall Street trader JP Morgan while the other was clocked to trading house Nova, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
